spans.s:
जड जड, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps corrupted fr.
rt. जल्, cf. जल), cold, frigid, chilly; stiff; stunned, para-
lyzed, motionless, apathetic, senseless, stupid, idiotic,
irrational, dumb; stunning, stupefying; (अस्), m. ‘the
stupid one,’ an epithet of Su-mati who, though intelli-
gent, simulated stupidity; cold, frost, winter; idiocy,
fatuity, stupidity; dulness, apathy, sluggishness of
mind or body; (आ), f. the plant Mucuna Pruritus;
also the plant Flacourtia Cataphracta [cf. जटा];
(अम्), n. water [cf. जल]; lead; [cf. Hib. fiod,
fuar.]
—जड-क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, working slowly or
stupidly, dilatory.
—जड-ता, f. or जड-त्व, अम्, n.
coldness, chilliness, frigidness, apathy, stupidity, stupe-
faction, despair.
—जड-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, stupid, idiotic.
—जड-भरत, अस्, m. ‘the stupid Bharata,’ N. of
a man simulating stupidity; an idiot in general.

जडिमन्, आ, m. frigidity, stupefaction, insensibility,
stupidity, dulness.

जडी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to stun,
stupify, benumb, congeal.
—जडी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्,
stunned, rendered cold or torpid or insensible, stupe-
fied, confounded, paralyzed.

जडी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्, to become
insensible or stupid or frozen or rigid.
—जडी-भाव,
अस्, m. frigidity, coldness, apathy, stupidity.
—जडी-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become torpid, stunned, stupefied,
paralyzed, infatuated.

जडुल जडुल, अस्, m. a freckle, a mark;
[cf. जटुल and जतु-मणि.]

जाड्य जाड्य, अम्, n. (fr. जड), coldness,
frigidity; stiffness, inactivity, apathy, sluggishness, in-
sensibility; absence of feeling in the tongue, taste-
lessness; dulness or coldness of intellect, stupidity,
folly.
—जाड्यारि (˚य-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of cold-
ness,’ the citron tree.

जडय, Nom. P. जडयति, &c., to make apa-
thetic, make motionless or lifeless.

जडात्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, or जडात्मन् (˚ड-आत्˚),
आ, आ, अ, insensible, void of sensation, calm, placid,
cool (said of the moon).
